gloss: person who has remarried; remarried person

definitions.gloss: person who has remarried; remarried person
definitions.explanation: someone who has married again after a previous marriage ended in divorce or the death of a spouse

examples.japanese: {再婚者|さいこんしゃ}の{割合|わりあい}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The proportion of remarried people is increasing.

examples.japanese: {再婚者|さいこんしゃ}には{子連|こづ}れの{場合|ばあい}もある。
examples.english: Some remarried people bring children from a previous marriage.

examples.japanese: {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}では{再婚者|さいこんしゃ}{向|む}けのプランも{用意|ようい}されている。
examples.english: Wedding venues also offer plans tailored for remarried couples.

notes:
A compound of {再婚|さいこん} (remarriage) and {者|しゃ} (person). Used in demographics, legal contexts, and discussions about family structures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再婚者|さいこんしゃ}の{割合|わりあい}: proportion of remarried people
- {再婚者|さいこんしゃ}{同士|どうし}: two remarried people (marrying each other)
- {子連|こづ}れ{再婚者|さいこんしゃ}: remarried person with children

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初婚者|しょこんしゃ}: person marrying for the first time
- バツイチ: divorced person (colloquial) — literally "one strike," from the × mark used to cross out a marriage record

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in statistics, legal documents, and news articles. In casual conversation, people are more likely to say {再婚|さいこん}した{人|ひと} (a person who remarried).
